_avail.description: 1G HDMI, Ethernet, and USB Scaling Decoder

ports.label: HDMI Out
ports.notes: HDMI output from decoded NAV stream. Also carries CEC.

ports.label: Audio Out
ports.notes: 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw, balanced/unbalanced stereo. De-embedded from decoded HDMI / NAV audio stream.

ports.label: NAV
ports.notes: 1Gbps Ethernet carrying PURE3 video over IP, audio over IP / AES67, USB extension, and management. PoE+ class 4 powered (alternate to 12VDC).

ports.label: EXT
ports.notes: Network-extension daisy-chain port (1Gbps). Pass-through for downstream NAV devices.

ports.label: RS-232
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 on a 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw shared with IR. Pin configuration Tx/Rx/Gnd.

ports.label: IR
ports.notes: TTL-level IR (carrier 30-300 kHz) on a 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw shared with RS-232. Pin configuration S/Gnd.

ports.label: USB
ports.notes: USB 2.0 high-speed extension over the NAV link. Single physical USB-C port configurable as host or device mode.

ports.label: USB Config
ports.notes: Front-panel USB Mini-B for Ethernet-over-USB device configuration.

ports.label: Power
ports.notes: External 12VDC PSU input (100-240VAC brick). 1G endpoints can alternatively be powered via PoE+ on the NAV RJ-45.
